Today is my 11th alive day. I was hit by an IED on August 26th, 2004 in Anbar Province, Iraq. I was fortunate enough to b revived by corpsmen and survived until today, but I lost one of my best friends that day. I've decided to make today, for me, a celebration instead of a day of mourning. I created this sub to help me do just that. I'm not sure there's really even a need for this sub, seeing as the number of combat wounded is disproportionately small compared to the general population, in turn meaning the Voat population of us is potentially nonexistent. However, this page will be here to discuss how you're dealing with things, resources for combat wounded veterans, or anything that pertains to life after war. Please enjoy this place and post often. Everyone needs a support group, perhaps this place can serve as that.
